cover.title:
OS-Omni 评测
最强模型比人类低 8.8 个点
cover.dek: OS-Omni 测电脑使用，最强的 Claude Opus 5.5 平均成功率 68.5%，人类是 77.3%。首日 👍99、GitHub 102 星，是 New 里热度最高的一篇。
cover.title_en:
OS-Omni benchmark:
the best model trails humans by 8.8 points
cover.dek_en: OS-Omni tests computer use. Claude Opus 5.5, the strongest model on it, averages a 68.5% success rate against 77.3% for humans. It drew 👍99 and 102 GitHub stars on day one, the hottest paper in New.

stickers.title: 新热点
stickers.text: 多 Agent 控制台最挤，t3code 日增 +1,292。
stickers.text_en: Multi-agent consoles are the busiest lane, with t3code up +1,292 stars in a day.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: SEEK 把经验沉淀成可复用程序，少了 77.6% 的模型请求。
stickers.text_en: SEEK turns experience into reusable programs and makes 77.6% fewer model requests.

stickers.title: HN 热帖
stickers.text: Notion 官方 MCP 被指注入隐藏追加销售指令，HN 58 分。
stickers.text_en: Notion's official MCP is accused of injecting hidden upsell instructions into agent context. 58 points on HN.
